name: Question 9
worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${x}_{32}$, we remove the $3$rd row and $2$nd column: 

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & ∗ & 2 & 3 \\ 5 & ∗ & 2 & 0 \\ ∗ & 6 & ∗ & ∗ \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{32}=|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 3 \\ 5 & 2 & 0 \\ -6 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}|
$$

  

Therefore, the cofactor of ${x}_{32}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{32} & =(-1)^{3+2}{M}_{32} \\  & =-{M}_{32} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 & 3 \\ 5 & 2 & 0 \\ -6 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

Question 9
?

Find the cofactor of x32 in X=[05235020−56−28−6310].

a
 −|023520−610|
b
 −|0206−28310|
c
−|052502−56−2|
d
 |023520−610|
e
|052502−56−2|
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, to get the minor of x32, we remove the 3rd row and 2nd column:

X=[0∗235∗20∗6∗∗−6∗10]

So, the minor is M32=|023520−610|

Therefore, the cofactor of x32 is C32=(−1)3+2M32=−M32=−|023520−610|.
